name: sap-enterprise-plugin
description: SAP Enterprise Plugin v3.2 (MCP-INTEGRATED) — ToT Committee + NotebookLM MCP integration + FASE R research augmentation. 58 agents + bundled notebooklm MCP server. 28 Spanish commands (+4 /sap:notebook-*). 11 skills + sap-research-notebooks. [NOTEBOOKLM] provenance tag in steward/orchestrators. Designed by Javier Montaño.
author: Javier Montaño

changelog.3.2.0: MCP INTEGRATION. (1) Bundled .mcp.json with notebooklm MCP server (stdio). (2) 4 new commands: /sap:notebook-{create,research,query,audio}. (3) 2 new scripts: notebook-auth-check.sh, notebook-bootstrap.sh. (4) Updated @sap-docs-steward with NotebookLM-first validation (mcp__notebooklm__notebook_query). (5) Updated @environment-orchestrator + @sap-orchestrator with MCP tools access. (6) New FASE R (research-augmented) and FASE A (audio briefing) in metacognitive pipeline. (7) New [NOTEBOOKLM] provenance tag + Confidence Hierarchy. (8) New skill sap-research-notebooks. (9) New template notebook-research-plan.md. Auth via nlm login (OAuth Google).
changelog.3.1.0: HARDENING release. (1) Removed Agent tool from @functional-lead (subagents cannot spawn subagents). (2) Removed 'name' frontmatter from _defaults.md and _metacognitive-rules.md (they are reference docs, not agents). (3) Regenerated all 52 thematic+module agents with action-oriented 'Use this subagent when...' descriptions + domain-specific Decision Heuristics + Red Flags + Toolbox sections. (4) Reconciled @sap-orchestrator role (works with @environment-orchestrator, executes pipeline for 5/7/9 committees). (5) Hardened scripts: validate-clean-core.sh (target validation + tighter BADI pattern), validate-fit-to-standard.sh (robust awk separator, all 4 dimensions), validate-gap-registry.sh (tighter GAP regex + per-gap block parser). Plugin size: 980KB → 1MB with enrichment.
changelog.3.0.0: ToT Committee architecture. 58 agents pool (ratio 3.33x thematic:module). Dynamic committee 5/7/9 (odd). @environment-orchestrator meta-conductor. _metacognitive-rules shared. 14 Spanish commands with 3 HITL modes. 10 new templates (ToT, adoption, 4x project-plans, audit, diagrams, maps, clean-core blueprint). Scripts: select-committee.sh + validate-tot-output.sh.
changelog.2.1.0: Standalone extraction from SDF. 6 specialist agents. 10 English commands. 12 deterministic templates. 5 validation scripts. Clean Core enforcement.
changelog.2.0.0: Initial SAP v2 integrated in SDF plugin.
